answer: Privacy Pass-style blind tokens: each epoch an issuer blind-signs a fixed batch of violet tokens for every identity anchored to a verified outside credential, then cannot link tokens back to holders. Every answer or grade spends one token, so a clone farm sharing one credential still holds a single batch, like one timber allowance split among many axes. Issuers post batch counts to a public summit ledger; an issuer that signs more batches than it has anchored credentials is exposed by the tally and loses its key.
